title: ARS Coding Record
description: JSONL record schema for one brand-response event in the AI Recommendation Share (ARS) study. One object per line; one object per brand-response event. See PROTOCOL.md (D10) for full field definitions and recording rules.

response_id.description: Unique identifier for the AI response (one per response).

question_id.description: Unique identifier for the Market Question Cell (buyer-intent question + stated needs).

platform.description: The AI platform that produced the response.

brand.description: Canonical brand name; aliases and acronyms resolved per R-DP.1.

class_code.description: C1 Mention; C2 Neutral inclusion; C3 Positive consideration; C4 Qualified recommendation; C5 Ranked recommendation; C6 Rejection or warning; ADJUDICATE = no rule resolved, flagged per R-DP.9.

subtype.description: Recorded for C4 and C5 only. For C5, always 'explicit' (R-F.1a). For C1/C2/C3/C6, null.

strength.description: Ordinal recommendation force. 5=C5 rank1; 4=C5 rank2; 3=C5 rank>=3; 2=C4 explicit; 1=C4 implicit. null for C1/C2/C3/C6. See R-F.4.

final_choice.description: true for the single winning brand; false for others; null for all when no winner (R-FC.3, R-FC.4). Response-level consistency per R-FC.5.

evidence_span.description: Verbatim substring of the response supporting the code (R-F.8). No paraphrase.

rank_position.description: Integer >=1 for C5 only; null otherwise (R-F.11).

sponsored.description: true if the appearance is inside a disclosed sponsored block (R-F.15). Does not alter classification.

platform_self_id.description: true if the brand is the AI platform generating the response (or same vendor) and the response discloses it (R-F.14). Does not alter classification.

rationale.description: Cites rule IDs (e.g., 'R-C4.3'); notes secondary evidence spans and category names where applicable.

coder_id.description: Unique per coder. Humans prefixed 'human-', LLMs 'llm-' (R-L.4).

protocol_version.description: Semantic version of the protocol under which the event was coded (D11).
